validity.researcher_notes: P1899 'UBTG-1-Berri 2' is a near-identical twin of P1898 'UBTG-1-Berri': length 247 km vs 249 km, identical multi-diameter profile (56, 36, 38, 40, 42 in) on both, same owner (Saudi Aramco), same status (operating), and both carry blank endpoints ('Saudi Arabia' -> 'Saudi Arabia'). Two truly independent trunk lines almost never share an identical five-value diameter list and differ by only ~2 km in length. The '2' suffix reads as a segmentation/loop artifact. This pair sits inside a larger km-post-labelled family (P1900 UBTG-km56-AY-1 KP916, P1901 UBTG-1km-Juaymah, P1910/P1911 UBTG-1-km0-UBTG-1-km56 [+ '2'], P1912 Hawiyah-UBTG-1-km0) whose names are kilometer-post node labels (km0, km56, KP916, KP943) characteristic of ONE modelled trunk (the Uthmaniyah-Berri Trunk Gas line, 'UBTG-1') carved into per-span rows in a GIS/technical dataset. A ResearchGate technical table titled 'UBTG-1 Pipeline Characteristics' (tbl3, pub 291522747) confirms UBTG-1 is treated as a single characterised pipeline in the literature, not a set of independent lines. CLAUDE.md explicitly warns this UBTG/Berri/Juaymah cluster is prone to double-count. Flagging P1899 as a duplicate candidate of P1898 for a human de-dup pass across the whole UBTG-1 family.

validity.recommendation: Do not treat as independently verified. Seek a primary Aramco/technical source that names 'UBTG-1' and its Berri branch/loop with a length+diameter table; if none exists, this row should be merged into the UBTG-1 trunk rather than standing as a distinct pipeline.
validity.researcher_notes: The row's only citations (from wiki_citations.json) are three generic OPEC Annual Statistical Bulletins (ASB 2012 p.75, ASB 2017 p.136, ASB 2013 p.79). OPEC ASBs are country-level statistical tables (reserves/production/refining) and do NOT name individual pipelines by km-post labels such as 'UBTG-1-Berri 2' -- they cannot support this row's existence, endpoints, length, or diameters. Independent web search returns NO source naming 'UBTG-1-Berri 2': every hit traces back to gem.wiki itself (not independent). GulfPub PE World Map -- Saudi Arabia's best-covered dataset (20 gas features) -- lists NO UBTG / Uthmaniyah-Berri line at all (its Berri entries are 'Qatif-Berri' and Berri-oilfield work); its silence on the entire UBTG family is itself a corroboration gap. The underlying SYSTEM is real (Aramco's Uthmaniyah/Hawiyah-Berri-Juaymah gas trunks; 'UBTG-3, a ~152 km line linking Uthmaniyah to Juaymah and Berri' appears in trade coverage), so this is not a phantom facility -- but the SPECIFIC standalone 247 km 'UBTG-1-Berri 2' pipeline is not independently verifiable and is best explained as a modelled segment of UBTG-1. Also note (spec/attribution caveats): length 247 km, the diameter list, and a blank capacity are all uncorroborated by any independent source that agrees with the GEM numbers; owner Saudi Aramco 100% is plausible (Aramco owns/operates the MGS) and Fuel=Gas is correct, but no cited source names this line's owner. No fabricated URLs or coordinates used.

routes.start_name: Uthmaniyah Gas Plant (approx.; inferred from 'UBTG' = Uthmaniyah-Berri Trunk Gas)
routes.corridor_desc: Best-supported reading of the name 'UBTG-1-Berri' (Uthmaniyah-Berri Trunk Gas) is a gas trunk from the Uthmaniyah gas-processing area in southern-central Ghawar (near Udhailiyah, Eastern Province) running generally northeast across the Eastern Province -- through the Shedgum/Abqaiq processing corridor -- to the Berri Gas Plant at Al Jubail on the Arabian Gulf coast. Great-circle Uthmaniyah->Berri is roughly 215-230 km, consistent with the sheet's 247 km routed length, which loosely cross-checks the corridor. Bound is LOOSE: only the endpoints are defensible. The Berri Gas Plant coordinate is sourced (26.954, 49.586); the Uthmaniyah start coordinate is an approximate facility-area estimate (Udhailiyah/Uthmaniyah, ~25.13N 49.30E), not a precisely sourced point. Intermediate path is not independently mapped. If a de-dup confirms P1899 is a loop of P1898, both share this corridor.
routes.researcher_notes: End endpoint (Berri Gas Plant, Al Jubail, Eastern Province) established from Saudipedia (names 'Berri Gas Plant') and mapcarta/OpenInfraMap (gives coordinates 26.954N, 49.586E); both verified via url_verifier (200 + token present). Start endpoint (Uthmaniyah Gas Plant) is INFERRED from the pipeline's own name/nomenclature ('UBTG-1' = Uthmaniyah-Berri Trunk Gas) plus trade coverage of the Uthmaniyah-Berri-Juaymah gas trunk system; its coordinate is an approximate area estimate, NOT precisely sourced -- flagged accordingly rather than fabricated to false precision. No coordinates invented; where unsure I kept the bound loose.

summary: P1899 UBTG-1-Berri 2 staged as CONCERN (duplicate of P1898 + existence/sourcing): near-identical twin of P1898 with identical diameter list, only OPEC-ASB generic citations, no independent naming, absent from GulfPub; likely a modelled segment/loop of the single UBTG-1 trunk. Route proposed Uthmaniyah GP -> Berri GP (Berri sourced, Uthmaniyah approx), suggested accuracy low.
